newsitem.title: GERMANY: Seven airlines launch ex-Frankfurt winter flights.
newsitem.headline: Seven airlines launch ex-Frankfurt winter flights.

text.p: Seven airlines will launch new services from Frankfurt airport this winter, airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt AG (FAG) said.
Newcomers include Brazilian airline VASP, Cuban national carrier Cubana and Armenian Airlines, an FAG statement said.
Airlines no longer flying ex-Frankfurt this winter include German charter airlines Aero Lloyd and Hapag-Lloyd, Canadian Airlines and private Russian carrier Transaero, an FAG spokesman said.
The number of passenger flights from Frankfurt will rise 1.7 percent to 3,141 a week in the winter schedule starting on October 27, the FAG statement said.
The 111 airlines operating out of Frankfurt will fly to 255 destinations, 13 more than last winter, in 116 countries, a rise of six on 1994-95.
Total seat capacity will rise seven percent, in particular to eastern and northern Europe, Africa, Latin America and Asia.
The number of domestic German flights will decline 1.1 percent as more passengers choose rail travel, the statement added.
